admission.justification: Closure predicates in cli/role_held_store.py, liveness settlement in cli/role_launch_liveness.py, and selection checks in cli/paseo_role_recipients.py enforce the corrected closure boundary across three modules.

applicability: Closure evaluation in held-store settlement, liveness readings, and message recipient selection.
conditions: Closure requires retiredBy, status rejected, leafArchive.closing, or host-confirmed archived or gone state.
A send validates request, agent, workspace, and heldStoreGeneration before filing or holding.
exclusions: A stopped status alone (such as an idle seat after a cancelled turn) never closes a seat or settles its store.

evidence: The Worker freeze report binds focused verification on this tree.

statement: Cancellation preserves a live seat's messages. Closure requires recorded retirement, rejected start, a closing archive mark, or host-confirmed archival or absence. A send keeps the generation it selected.
title: Seat closure needs durable or host proof and sends keep selected generation
